observation: An explicit labels-on override replaced the package labels array. A same-data/same-size replay omitting only this option restored readable outside donut labels.
acceptance: Enabling labels must retain applicable library layout/overlap defaults.
Meaning-bearing donut labels are readable; CSV values and units are unchanged.
optimization_use: Fix/test deterministic harness behavior before prompt optimization.

observation: Renderer-owned findings blocked supported designer presentation repairs. Repeated attempts, publication and revision exhausted the shared model budget in retained cases.
acceptance: A supported presentation repair is not blocked solely because the finding owner is renderer.
Control returns to the lead with actionable diagnostics; unchanged repair cycles cannot masquerade as progress.
Framework resource limits remain enforced and the final outcome is explicit.
optimization_use: Harness regression first; do not teach the model to circumvent the repair gate.

observation: Both arms rendered all 17 region/city rows with correct headers. False header-swap or RTL-order findings discarded valid PNGs.
acceptance: Reject only an evidenced header/value mismatch, not correct RTL presentation.
Check accessible content separately from the visible viewport; scrollbar cropping alone is not a defect.
This specific static PNG must contain all 17 rows under the correct headers.
optimization_use: Candidate reviewer calibration after adjudication; raw revise verdict is not a gold label.

observation: Some findings remained structured errors while their prose retracted the alleged mismatch or explicitly said the values were correct.
acceptance: Verdict, severity and evidence must agree; a retracted claim is not an actionable error.
Check the actual image/data pairing before deciding pass or revise.
The lead must not claim a review passed when its saved state is revise.
optimization_use: Review-output consistency and evidence calibration, not blind verdict imitation.

observation: Correct RTL bars show 6,5,4,4,4. Two GLM PNGs are byte-identical; an alleged ascending-order issue drove redundant work.
acceptance: Interpret order using the declared direction and value/category bindings.
Do not request an identical redraw for a nonexistent ordering defect.
optimization_use: Candidate negative example for unsupported visual findings.

observation: The GLM chart retained F/M, but the final prose decoded them without a codebook despite the handoff. Numeric checks alone did not catch this.
acceptance: Keep F/M literal unless code_meanings explicitly defines them.
Check final prose for unsupported semantic claims as well as numeric fidelity.
optimization_use: Lead semantic-fidelity regression; not a renderer defect.

observation: The literal column name count_under_30 triggered an invented-number rejection although counts and percentages in this retained reply were correct.
acceptance: Treat literal column identifiers as context, not newly asserted data values.
Continue rejecting actual invented numeric claims.
Keep historical raw scores unchanged and write any correction as a separate rescore.
optimization_use: Fix the metric before using it as a DSPy reward.

observation: The GLM PNG has genuine short population-bar labels colliding with city labels; the Claude PNG on the same source is readable.
acceptance: Category text and visible value labels do not collide.
A supported labels-off presentation is acceptable if values remain accessible and series/units remain identifiable.
Preserve the complete source; never fabricate or aggregate the count/rate fields.
optimization_use: Chart presentation regression, with source correctness scored separately.

observation: Correct Claude-arm charts exceeded the 60-second SLA. Stage evidence attributes substantial waiting to the shared GLM lead/provider, including a 92.81-second tool-return-to-final gap after publication in one case.
acceptance: Measure end-to-end delivered reply latency, not rendering time alone.
Do not label shared-lead waiting as a Claude designer failure.
Compare repeated matched runtime runs before attributing a latency improvement to a prompt.
optimization_use: Full-runtime metric and latency diagnostics, not first-action proxy scoring.

observation: The Claude-arm male-count-zero case timed out in the GLM lead before any designer call, with no rendered image.
acceptance: A no-image timeout cannot pass visual quality or count as a completed chart.
Attribute a failure to the stage actually called; preserve its attempted outcome in the denominator.
Keep the bounded watchdog and do not retry indefinitely.
optimization_use: Runtime failure/timeout regression; not a Claude chart-design label.
